name: Mama Shibori 2 (Mama Shibori no Jijou)
original_name: ママしぼり2（ママしぼりの事情）
source:
The protagonist is a boy, Hobara Nao. He is avoiding his mother, who is worried and, wanting to be a good mother, faces her son and asks him what is wrong. It seems he has a special health-problem, so she decides to take him to doctor, a woman-doctor of course.
She examines him and concludes he has rare sickness and that there is only one cure. The cure is nothing less than the son 'releasing' himself by receiving the 'special' love from his lovely beautiful mother. Of course the woman-doctor and many other beautiful mature ladies helps the mother in her task curing her son. In the end will the son be cured?

[Description edited from a post bySheMale77 on Hongfire forums]
translation:
主人公是少年保原尚。他一直躲着母亲，忧心忡忡的母亲想做一个称职的妈妈，于是与儿子认真交谈，询问究竟出了什么问题。他似乎患有一种特殊疾病，因此母亲决定带他去看医生——当然，是一位女医生。
医生检查后断定他患有罕见疾病，而且只有一种治疗方法：儿子必须接受美丽母亲“特殊”的爱，并通过“释放”自己得到治愈。当然，这位女医生和许多其他美丽熟女也会帮助母亲完成治疗。最终，儿子能痊愈吗？

[根据HongFire论坛SheMale77的帖子编辑]
